author: Rick Fritz
text: I was a Dexcom user for 3 years.  The first 2 years were good, but then almost every sensor thereafter had to be replaced due to inaccuracies.  I got free L3P samples from my doctor and and I immediately noticed a much better experience.  That was 4 months ago and regretted not having Libre from the very beginning.  The accuracy, much smaller size, and 15-day length are awesome!

author: Gannie Gee
text: I  had the choice between dexcom or libre.  I have friends that use decom and they have the same issues. Im on my 3rd  libre plus  and I have been ok.  When it reads low. I do a back up finger stick right at that moment.  I went with libre because at the time my doctor was out of the dexcom.  I could have switched however I love the size.   The manual will tell you if it is in a 10 point range your ok.  So I  stayed with the libre 3 plus
